metric.description: The consumption metric this goal targets.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

periodEnd.description: Canonical UTC instant marking the exclusive end of the goal's period `[periodStart, periodEnd)`, serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

updatedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

formatScope.description: Optional restriction of this goal to one format category (e.g. only audiobooks). Unset means the goal counts consumption of all formats. Only meaningful when `metric` is `completed_state_count` — never populated alongside a sum metric.

periodLabel.description: Optional free-text label for the goal's period (e.g. '2026 Reading Challenge'), for display only. Not used to compute the period boundaries — periodStart/periodEnd remain authoritative.

periodStart.description: Canonical UTC instant marking the inclusive start of the goal's period, serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

targetValue.description: The target value to reach for `metric` within the goal's period. The maximum is 999,999 hours expressed in seconds (999999 * 3600) — the field is not per-metric here, so it is bounded to the widest unit's ceiling; `completed_state_count`/`page_count_sum` goals are additionally capped at 999,999.

main.description: A repeatable consumption-goal record for an actor, targeting a metric over a half-open time period `[periodStart, periodEnd)` (periodStart is inclusive, periodEnd is exclusive). Fulfillment progress against the goal is not stored on this record — it is computed at read time by filtering the actor's `library.state` records that fall within the period, per the metric named in `metric`.
